# Adam Sowden

> Autonomous AI marketing systems for service-business owners. Trained on your specific business, they write, publish, follow up, and book prospects while you direct the strategy. Built for owners who want results without becoming a marketing department.

Adam Sowden is a direct-response marketer and founder whose campaigns booked appointments totalling over $1 billion in advisor assets for financial advisers. He now encodes that direct-response and lead-generation expertise into AI systems that outperform in-house teams, agencies, and off-the-shelf tools. Currently working with a limited number of new clients per quarter.

## Start here

- [AI Marketing Diagnostic](https://adamsowden.com/diagnostic): Free, seven to ten minutes. An AI-led conversation that finds where AI marketing automation will move your sales fastest, with a personalised implementation plan at the end.
- [Book a Quick Chat](https://adamsowden.com/book): A 20-minute conversation, no pitch, about where AI marketing automation would deliver the biggest lift in your sales right now.
- [About Adam Sowden](https://adamsowden.com/about): Background, track record, and the method behind the systems.

## Products

Six modular AI marketing systems that run without you.

- [The Speed-to-Lead Agent](https://adamsowden.com/products/speed-to-lead-agent): Watches your forms, email, and SMS around the clock and replies to every new enquiry in seconds, before a competitor sees it.
- [The Outreach Agent](https://adamsowden.com/products/outreach-agent): Finds the people already interacting with you and continues the conversation in the right channel. Warm relationship building, not cold prospecting.
- [The Site Conversation Agent](https://adamsowden.com/products/site-conversation-agent): A conversational AI on every page that engages visitors, qualifies them, and books calls in real time.
- [Irene, Your Own AI Marketing Team](https://adamsowden.com/products/ai-marketing-team): Trained on your voice and methodology. Plans the week and drafts the content while you are away. You approve, she ships.
- [The Content Ecosystem](https://adamsowden.com/products/content-ecosystem): A Living AI Website, a weekly content engine, and a diagnostic tool that captures and qualifies intent before the first human conversation.
- [The Marketing Ecosystem](https://adamsowden.com/products/marketing-ecosystem): Paid acquisition and distribution run as a system, so the strategy, trained voice, and results stay inside your business.
- [Products overview](https://adamsowden.com/products): All six systems compared.

## Who this is for

Owners of service businesses with specialist or high-end offers, including financial advisers, consultants, and professional services firms, who want marketing that runs as a system under their direction rather than another tool to operate or an agency to manage.
